notes: Dev ABox revision carried by the inverse property: on_river is the inverse of flows_through, so the related question asks a different stored statement from the river's side (is Budapest one of the national capitals along the Danube: yes, then no). on_river is many-valued, so the edit says 'the only river', which makes the Rhine replace the Danube; that is also why 'the river that Budapest lies on' picks out one river in the derived questions. Derived: three compositions that follow the edit to the Rhine and look up a stored fact about it (its source country, the sea it flows into, whether it passes Cologne). on_river has no transitive, chain or subproperty tag, so these use derivation none. Near unrelated asks the river of another Danube capital. Counts are exact-phrase Dolma counts except those marked approximate. Related: how many national capitals the Danube flows through (composition: four, then three once Budapest is no longer on it; stored whole in Wikipedia's Danube article, a fact about the river and the other capitals, not the edited pair restated). The earlier related questions were the edited pair read the other way (is Budapest a national capital on the Danube) and Margaret Island in 'the river that Budapest lies on', a composed sentence nobody writes.
